{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently 0.02-0.10 too high compared to true outcomes, indicating upward bias/lag that needs correction",
    "When sentiment is positive (≥0.67), apply 0.5-1.0% downward correction to forecasts to prevent overshooting",
    "When sentiment is negative (≤0.33), apply 0.5-1.0% upward correction to forecasts to prevent undershooting",
    "Sentiment alignment rule: forecast direction must match sentiment trend, reversing when sentiment flips",
    "Mean reversion bias exists - forecasts at extremes (above 66 or below 62) should be pulled toward 64-65 range",
    "Lag correction: early forecast points (first 7-10 days) require 0.03-0.05 adjustment to match true outcome lag",
    "Sentiment-missing scenarios: when sentiment history is sparse or unclear, default to 1:1 mapping between forecast trend and sentiment trend" ]}
